readerEvidence.summary: Single-pass direct Astra reading of every original page: 12 problem pages and 16 matching official-solution pages. Six independent problems retained, with Roman/numbered native sections and nested numbered/letter parts. Native tables preserve all 75 spectrographic measurements and 73 galaxies, including the blank PGC12680 magnitude. All four appended blank graph sheets retained as explicitly editorial shared-pack appendix, not invented tasks. Full 24-entry 2016 catalogue inspected: paired same-directory Practice problems/solutions cover all six training tasks; final-round spdata and selection-round Excel/quizzes belong to separate source packs. No extra matching training key/rubric is catalogued. Printed defects retained: task5 major semiaxis described as equal to diameter; inclination calculation and mass graph values unchanged; task6 angular-distance formula divides RA difference by sin declination and subtracts declination square, virial prose says potential and gravitational energy, histogram range starts900 despite NGC1400 velocity415. NGC1300 angular size differs between task5 and task6 table. Partial official annotations and task6 missing explicit requested final values recorded, not filled with invented solutions. No independent model checker.
sourceGaps: Task 1 official solution omits the requested sea crosses and crater-location circles; crater diameters and phase/FOV image are present.

Tasks 2–4 official charts show outlines and selected annotations but do not spell out all requested constellation names and compass labels; the task 4 chart has a label clipped at its original upper edge.
Task 6 official solution explains the scale/radius method but gives no explicit final minimum-field or diameter result.
Task 6 data table leaves the B magnitude of PGC 12680 blank.
